exams.name: Architect licensure examination
exams.notes: Examination prescribed by the board; administered by a testing service; applicants have 3 years from board approval to complete examination.
exams.quote: an applicant seeking to obtain a license to practice architecture in Kentucky shall satisfactorily pass the examination that is prescribed by the board

available.quote: Any person who is a licensed architect in another state or country where the qualifications prescribed at the time of licensing were, in the opinion of the board, equal to those prescribed in the Commonwealth at the date of application, and where reciprocal licensing privileges satisfactory to the board are granted to licensees of the Commonwealth, may be granted a license without an examination.

definition_quote.value: The 'practice of architecture' is the rendering or offering to render certain services, hereinafter described, in connection with the design and construction of a structure or group of structures which have as their principal purpose human habitation or use, and the utilization of space within and surrounding such structures. The services referred to in the previous sentence include planning, providing preliminary studies, designs, drawings and specifications, and administration of construction contracts
definition_quote.quote: The "practice of architecture" is the rendering or offering to render certain services, hereinafter described, in connection with the design and construction of a structure or group of structures which have as their principal purpose human habitation or use, and the utilization of space within and surrounding such structures. The services referred to in the previous sentence include planning, providing preliminary studies, designs, drawings and specifications, and administration of construction contracts

interior_designer_certification_availabl.quote: "Certified interior designer" means a person who is certified to use the title "certified interior designer" in accordance with KRS 323.400 to 323.416 and 323.992 by meeting the criteria of education, experience, and examination as determined by the board

interior_design_services_defined.quote: Nothing in KRS 323.400 to 323.416 or 323.992 prohibits a person who is not certified as a certified interior designer from providing interior design services or from using any title, sign, card, or device indicating that the person provides interior design services.

seal_required.quote: Each architect licensed for practice within the Commonwealth shall obtain a seal of the design prescribed in administrative regulations promulgated by the board.

seal_surrender_required_on_license_termi.quote: When the certificate of a certified interior designer has been revoked or suspended, the certified interior designer shall surrender his or her certificate to the board within thirty (30) days after the revocation or suspension has become effective.

value: Any building which is to be used for farm purposes only
Any residential structure that does not require the services or seal of an architect or engineer
Any building classified by use group other than those listed under KRS 323.033 so long as the services or seal of an architect or engineer is not required
Any structure not classified as a building by KRS 323.010(4)
exempt_building_types.quote: this chapter does not apply to: (a) Any building which is to be used for farm purposes only; (b) Any residential structure that does not require the services or seal of an architect or engineer either under the Uniform State Building Code pursuant to KRS 198B.050 or under KRS 323.033; (c) Any building classified by use group other than those listed under KRS 323.033 so long as the services or seal of an architect or engineer as applicable is not required for such other use group under the Uniform State Building Code pursuant to KRS 198B.050 or; (d) Any structure not classified as a building by KRS 323.010(4).

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.quote: Whoever violates KRS 323.020 or 323.230 is guilty of a Class A misdemeanor.

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: the board may, in lieu of or in addition to other penalties, impose a civil penalty not to exceed ten thousand dollars ($10,000)
